data.opportunityTitle: Mentored Clinician Research Scientist Career Development Award (KC1)

topAgencyDetails.agencyName: Department of Health and Human Services

forecast.forecastDesc: The Mentored Clinician Research Scientist Career Development Award provides support to clinician research scientists for a sustained period of protected time (up to five years) for intensive research career development under the guidance of an experienced mentor.  The award is intended to prepare candidates with clinical doctoral degrees for future research independence.
